text.aria-label: Title text 'Power against 100 m wind speed'

Subtitle text 'Black: observed median and 5% to 95% band in bins of ERA5 speed at the valid time. Coloured: each arm's median forecast in bins of the ensemble-mean speed at forecast time; dashed: the default's and M's 5% and 95% quantiles. Grey dotted: cut-in; grey dashed: rated speed; blue band: experiment 210 idle band. Scored year, all half-hours, 1 to 10 days. W1 to W3 are anonymised farms; the last panel pools them.'
text.tspan: Black: observed median and 5% to 95% band in bins of ERA5 speed at the valid time. Coloured:
each arm's median forecast in bins of the ensemble-mean speed at forecast time; dashed: the
default's and M's 5% and 95% quantiles. Grey dotted: cut-in; grey dashed: rated speed; blue
band: experiment 210 idle band. Scored year, all half-hours, 1 to 10 days. W1 to W3 are
anonymised farms; the last panel pools them.
